solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cut into vehicle — someone trapped may be this?

indicators.note: into tells us the word for cut goes inside the vehicle

parts.note: a sled is a vehicle on runners
to hack is to cut roughly

explanation.surface: Rescuers cutting into a crashed car to free someone trapped inside.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests firefighters cutting open a car; the vehicle is really one that runs on snow.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who is trapped may be in chains or fetters, which is what shackled describes.

clue.text: In kitchen ban every herb that could be lethal?

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of words that follow

explanation.surface: A cook bans every poisonous herb from the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Henbane is a poisonous plant of the nightshade family, toxic enough to kill.

clue.text: Ditch sermon? That's bad for body of believers

indicators.note: calling the words bad says they are wrong as they stand and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A churchgoer complains that skipping the sermon is wrong for the faithful.
explanation.definitionFit: Christendom is the worldwide community of Christians, the whole body of the faithful.

clue.text: City drains needing black flushed out

indicators.note: flushed out means the letter for black is removed

parts.note: bleeds means drains, as of fluid or money
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A city's drains need the dark sludge flushed away.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeds is a large city in Yorkshire, northern England.

clue.text: Comatose fellow coming in walked the wrong way

indicators.note: coming in tells us the fellow enters the other word
the wrong way means the word for walked is read backwards

parts.note: trod is the past tense of tread, to walk
a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: A sleepwalker wanders in a stupor, going in the wrong direction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Walked the wrong way' paints a sleepwalker, but it is a reversal signal applied to the past tense of tread.
explanation.definitionFit: Dormant means inactive or asleep, close in sense to being unconscious.

clue.text: Good-looker in a party turning evil

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration

indicators.note: turning means the word for evil is read backwards

parts.note: sin is evil, wrongdoing

explanation.surface: A handsome guest at a party starts to behave badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Adonis was the beautiful youth of Greek myth, so his name is used for any very handsome man.

clue.text: Company boy among experts gets honours

indicators.note: among puts company and boy inside the word for experts

parts.note: aces are experts
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A firm's young employee wins awards alongside the specialists.
explanation.definitionFit: Accolades are awards or praise given in recognition, just as honours are.

clue.text: Sorcery of African people on the up

indicators.note: in a down clue, on the up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the Ibo or Igbo are a people of Nigeria

explanation.surface: Witchcraft among an African people is growing.
explanation.definitionFit: Obi, or obeah, is a kind of folk magic practised in the Caribbean, a crossword favourite.

clue.text: Thoughtless person put stuff to be burnt here?

definitions.text: put stuff to be burnt here?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as two words: an instruction to place fuel inside the fireplace

explanation.surface: Someone careless tosses things into the fireplace.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into two words, IN and GRATE, for the instruction reading.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingrate is an ungrateful person, one who gives no thought to kindness received.

clue.text: Very distressing war never troubled China's foremost ruler

indicators.note: troubled suggests the letters of war never are disturbed into a new order
foremost picks out the first letter of China's

parts.note: its first letter, C
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: A Chinese emperor is upset by a war that never seems to end.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranging WAR NEVER gives NERVEWRA; add C from China and KING.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nerve-wracking strains the nerves, causing great anxiety and upset.

clue.text: The old man exploits gaps in conversation?

parts.note: pa is a familiar name for one's father, the old man
to exploit something is to use it; uses is the verb form

explanation.surface: Father takes advantage of lulls in a chat.
explanation.definitionFit: Pauses are brief silences or breaks, such as those in a conversation.

clue.text: Shout first to last to bring to king encouraging message

indicators.note: first to last means the opening letter of the word for shout moves to the end

parts.note: to call is to shout
Lear is Shakespeare's king

explanation.surface: A herald cries out from start to finish to bring good news to the king.
explanation.walkthrough: CALL with its C moved to the end becomes ALLC; KING LEAR is the Shakespeare tragedy.
explanation.definitionFit: An all-clear is a signal that danger is over, so it reassures people.

clue.text: Newcomer gaining ground?

parts.note: sounds like an upstart rising in status, but literally someone seizing territory

explanation.walkthrough: 'Gaining ground' suggests making progress; here it means literally taking land.
explanation.definitionFit: A land-grabber seizes territory unfairly, often an incomer taking property from others.

clue.text: Son put into river in a box is treated with disrespect

indicators.note: put into signals that the letter for son goes inside the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
S is the genealogy abbreviation for son
crated means packed in a crate, a box

explanation.surface: A son is dumped in a river inside a box, a shocking act of contempt.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee flows through Wales and England; S goes after its D to give DESE.
explanation.definitionFit: Desecrated means violated or profaned, something sacred handled with a lack of respect.

clue.text: Animal killer in ridiculous energy-wasting operations

indicators.note: ridiculous suggests the letters are absurdly jumbled
wasting means the energy letter is used up and lost from the fodder

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A pest controller's procedures are absurdly inefficient.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove E from OPERATIONS and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Rat poison is a substance laid down to kill rodents.

clue.text: Holiday period problem for US rail travellers?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: Christmas, the festive season
second meaning, read as two words: having ..., Chicago's elevated railway, troubles American commuters

explanation.walkthrough: In the US the El is the elevated railway, most famously in Chicago; split the answer into two words for the second reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Noel is another name for Christmas, the festive season of late December.

clue.text: A British journalist is lying

parts.note: ed, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A British reporter is not telling the truth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lying' looks like dishonesty but means reclining.
explanation.definitionFit: Abed means in bed, so someone abed is lying down.

clue.text: Like a market sometimes, one about to offer precious metals

parts.note: a bull market is one with rising prices
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A trader in a rising market offers gold and silver.
explanation.definitionFit: Bullion is gold or silver in bulk, valued by weight, as bars or ingots.

clue.text: Radio announcement of how the enemy is advancing?

definitions.text: Radio announcement of how the enemy is advancing?

parts.words: Radio announcement of how the enemy is advancing?
parts.note: time is called the enemy in the old saying, and the radio pips mark its progress hour by hour

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a wartime bulletin, but 'the enemy' is time, as in 'time is the enemy'.
explanation.definitionFit: The radio pips broadcast on the hour let listeners set clocks to the exact hour.

clue.text: Woman is gentle, looking angry

parts.note: mild means gentle
red in the face means angry

explanation.surface: A gentle woman suddenly looks furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Mildred is a female given name, so it can stand for any lady.

clue.text: Most mischievous revolutionary's limited in skill

indicators.note: limited in means the revolutionary's name is held within the word for skill

parts.note: art is skill
Che Guevara is the crossword revolutionary; Che's gives CHES

explanation.surface: A rebel's talent is restricted, which is very naughty.
explanation.walkthrough: Che Guevara is the stock crossword revolutionary; the possessive keeps its S.
explanation.definitionFit: Arch means playfully roguish, so the superlative means the most cheeky or teasing.

clue.text: Reforming MP, Liberal, I'm second in election

indicators.note: in places Liberal, I'm and second inside the word for election

parts.note: a poll is an election or vote

explanation.surface: A Liberal candidate boasts of coming second in a poll.
explanation.walkthrough: Samuel Plimsoll was the Victorian MP who campaigned for ship safety; the Plimsoll line on hulls is named after him.
explanation.definitionFit: Samuel Plimsoll was a nineteenth-century parliamentarian famous for his campaign to make merchant shipping safer.

clue.text: Shot at Lord's gardener's head with old weapon

indicators.note: head picks the first letter of gardener's

parts.note: its first letter, G
a lance is a long spear once used by knights

explanation.surface: Someone fires at a lord's gardener with an antique weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord's is the London cricket ground; a glance is a stroke deflecting the ball fine.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a glance is a deft batting stroke that deflects the ball off the bat's face.

clue.text: Country attire, not right when it's getting worn

indicators.note: not right means the letter for right is left out

parts.note: garb is clothing, attire
clothes that are on are being worn

explanation.surface: A nation's dress is wrong for the occasion it is worn.
explanation.definitionFit: Gabon is a nation on the west coast of Africa.

clue.text: Evil in sacred Bible is beyond words

indicators.note: evil suggests the letters are corrupted into a different order

explanation.surface: The wickedness recorded in scripture is too terrible to describe.
explanation.definitionFit: Indescribable means too extreme or unusual to be put into language.

clue.text: The first man lacks a mother

indicators.note: lacks means the word for the first man goes without the letter a

parts.note: Adam was the first man in Genesis

explanation.surface: Adam, the first man, had no mother.
explanation.definitionFit: A dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse or other livestock.

clue.text: Caster of shadow in garden? Little fellow therein cut one short

indicators.note: cut means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: the little fellow in a garden is a gnome

indicators.note: short means the word for one is missing its last letter

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A garden sundial casts a shadow; a garden gnome is cut down to size.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Therein' points back to the garden: the little fellow found there is a GNOME, which loses its E, as does ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A gnomon is the pointer on a sundial whose shadow tells the time, a common garden ornament.

clue.text: Crystal read finally — aim with special procedure

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of read

parts.note: its last letter, D
an end is an aim or goal
a rite is a ceremonial procedure

explanation.surface: A crystal-gazer reads the future with a special ritual.
explanation.definitionFit: A dendrite is a crystal with a branching, tree-like form, as in a snowflake.
